bugClass.title: Packaged Electron startup depends on executable naming
bugClass.cause: Packaged-only startup work is gated on Electron's `app.isPackaged`, but the packaging configuration preserves or changes the executable name in a way that makes the runtime report false. This skips packaged initialization and can leave shipped bundle files with unsafe permissions. A missing assembled-app launch check allows the mismatch through.
bugClass.criteria: Include a site when its Electron packaging or startup configuration makes packaged-runtime detection depend on executable identity or naming, causing `app.isPackaged` to be false in the assembled application and thereby skipping packaged-only setup. Also include sites where bundle assets are emitted or copied with world-writable permissions as a separate manifestation of the same packaging configuration failure. Either manifestation qualifies independently; prioritize runtime and packaging source, not tests, servers, or workers.

candidates.evidence: The Tracker initializer returns early unless `app.isPackaged` is true on macOS, then starts the bundled Tracker after Electron is ready (`initializeTrackerBundle.ts:11-20`). The trigger is a packaged Mac launch; the excerpt does not include the packaging configuration or assembled-app launch evidence needed to establish that the executable name makes `isPackaged` false.
